games.title: Pythle
games.description: A smart five-letter word puzzle solver. Mark your tiles and it ranks the best next guess.
games.controls: Click tiles to mark grey / yellow / green, then pick a suggested guess

games.title: Let's Open A Bar!
games.description: Build the bar you've always talked about, then find out if you'd actually be any good at running it.
games.controls: Mouse or touch: click or tap to build and interact, drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom. Keyboard: Q/E rotate, Space pauses, H hides the UI. On a phone, play with it held sideways.

games.title: FerVR Grid Room
games.description: An experimental WebXR space: a black grid room filled with glowing spheres driven by data. Best with a VR headset.
games.controls: Look around with the mouse. On a VR headset, use Enter VR.
